mathematics.assertion_tested: For the explicitly enumerated or deterministically constructed finite-group carriers, an equivariant idempotent modulo p^(e+k) corrects after averaging and polynomial Newton iteration to an equivariant idempotent modulo p^D, retaining the prescribed matrix modulo p^k. Also test exact adverse examples.
